en: Why can't I access my task?
or: mora task ebe bhi locked achhi
hi: main task access kyu nahi kar pa raha hoon
mera task abhi bhi locked hai

answers.en: A task becomes available according to the task progression rules of your course or internship. A locked task may require the previous task to be approved before it becomes available.
answers.or: Course ba internship ra task progression rules anusare task unlock hue. Locked task pain previous task approval darkar hei pare.
answers.hi: Course ya internship ke task progression rules ke according task unlock hota hai. Locked task ke liye previous task ka approval zaroori ho sakta hai.
answers.mixed: Course ba internship ra task progression rules anusare task unlock hue. Locked task pain previous task approval darkar hei pare.

en: How much time do I get for a task?
How long do I have to submit a task?
How many hours do I get for a task?
or: task complete karibaku kete time mile
task submit karibaku kete time achhi
hi: task complete karne ke liye kitna time milta hai
task submit karne ke liye kitna time hai
task ke liye kitne hours milte hain
mixed: task complete karibaku kete time mile
task submit karibaku kitna time achhi

answers.en: After a task is unlocked, you have 48 hours to complete and submit it. If the deadline passes before submission, the task becomes expired.
answers.or: Task unlock heba pare taku complete au submit karibaku 48 hours time mile. Deadline purbaru submit na kale task expired hei jiba.
answers.hi: Task unlock hone ke baad use complete aur submit karne ke liye 48 hours milte hain. Deadline se pehle submit nahi karne par task expired ho jayega.
answers.mixed: Task unlock heba pare complete au submit karibaku 48 hours mile. Deadline purbaru submit na kale task expired hei jiba.

en: What should I do if my task expired?
Can I submit an expired task?
hi: task expire hone par kya karun
mere task ki deadline khatam ho gayi
kya main expired task submit kar sakta hoon
mixed: mora task expired hei gala, kana karibi
task deadline sari gala kana karibi

answers.en: An expired task cannot be submitted normally. If you need an extension or have a valid issue, please contact the support team through Help & Support.
answers.or: Expired task normal bhabare submit karipariba nahi. Extension darkar thile ba valid problem thile Help & Support madhyama re support team ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Expired task ko normally submit nahi kiya ja sakta. Agar aapko extension chahiye ya koi valid issue hai, to Help & Support ke through support team se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Expired task normal bhabare submit hei pariba nahi. Extension darkar thile Help & Support madhyama re support team ku contact kara.

en: How long does task approval take?
My task is waiting for approval
What happens after I submit a task?
or: mora task ku kie approve karibe
mora task approval pain wait karuchi
task submit kariba pare kana hue
hi: task approval mein kitna time lagta hai
mera task approval ke liye wait kar raha hai
task submit karne ke baad kya hota hai
mixed: mora task ku kie approve karibe
mera task approval pain wait karuchi
task submit kariba pare kya haba

answers.en: After you submit a task, it goes through the admin review process. The next task can become available according to the task progression rules after the required approval.
answers.or: Task submit kariba pare admin review process re jaye. Required approval pare task progression rules anusare next task available hei pare.
answers.hi: Task submit karne ke baad woh admin review process mein jata hai. Required approval ke baad task progression rules ke according next task available ho sakta hai.
answers.mixed: Task submit kariba pare admin review process re jaye. Required approval pare progression rules anusare next task available hei pare.
